settings.title: How do I place an order?
settings.content: To place an order, browse through our products, select the item you wish to purchase, choose the size/color (if applicable), and click 'Add to Cart.' Once you’re ready, proceed to checkout to complete your order.

settings.title: What payment methods do you accept?
settings.content: We accept various payment methods, including major credit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express), PayPal, and other secure payment options available at checkout.

settings.title: How can I track my order?
settings.content: Once your order is shipped, you will receive a confirmation email with a tracking number. Use this number on our website or the carrier’s website to track your order.

settings.title: Do you offer international shipping?
settings.content: Yes, we offer international shipping. Shipping costs and delivery times vary depending on the destination.

settings.title: What are the shipping costs?
settings.content: Shipping costs are calculated at checkout based on your location and the shipping method selected.

settings.title: What is your return policy?
settings.content: We accept returns within 30 days of delivery. Items must be in their original condition, unused, and with all tags attached. Please visit our Returns Policy page for more details.

settings.title: How do I return an item?
settings.content: To return an item, please contact our customer service team at [email/contact info] with your order number and reason for return. We will provide you with a return authorization and instructions.

settings.title: Do I need an account to place an order?
settings.content: No, you can place an order as a guest. However, creating an account allows you to track orders, save your information for faster checkout, and view your order history.

settings.title: How can I provide feedback about my shopping experience?
settings.content: We welcome your feedback! You can leave a review on our website or contact our customer service team directly.

settings.title: Do you offer any discounts or promotions?
settings.content: Yes, we periodically offer discounts and promotions. To stay updated, sign up for our newsletter and follow us on social media.

settings.title: How do I use a promo code?
settings.content: Enter your promo code at checkout in the designated box and click 'Apply.' The discount will be reflected in your total.

settings.title: How can I contact customer support?
settings.content: You can contact our customer support team through our contact form on the website.
